Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Massaman Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and scatter with peanuts. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk and 200 ml water, adding the pepper and beans for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and stir in the basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry paste.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lime leaves and 200 ml water, adding the eggplant and zucchini for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar. Taste for salt.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Lemongrass Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and soy sauce with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill in one layer.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Scatter with coriander and serve with lime wedges.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Thai Gai Yang-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, coriander, pepper and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a rack over a lined tray.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic Pepper Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and chilies for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the glossy garlic sauce over.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Beef Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss with the onion, mint and toasted rice powder and spoon into lettuce leaves.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Beef Stir-Fry
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Stir in the basil and serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
Serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Black Bean Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the black bean sauce, soy sauce, sugar and 4 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Kung Pao Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the dried chilies and Sichuan pepper for 30 seconds, then with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the peanuts and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Broccoli and Oyster Sauce Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce and 3 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the broccoli with 3 tbsp water (cover 2 minutes to steam) and with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Finish with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Sweet and Sour Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and pineapple with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until everything is coated in the bright sauce.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Beef Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces
Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Red-Braised Short Ribs Hong Shao

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (1 tbsp dark if you have it)

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the star anise and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauces, wine, sugar and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Uncover for the last 15 minutes and boil until the sauce is sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the five-spice.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, hoisin, wine, carrots and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Five-Spice Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the five-spice.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, hoisin, wine, carrots and 400 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Roast Chinese Char Siu-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice, wine and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Set on a rack over a lined tray and brush with more marinade halfway.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Honey Soy Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Ginger Scallion Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and white pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the ginger and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, wine and 4 tbsp water.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Drizzle with the sesame oil.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo-Style Beef Tofu
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the chili bean paste and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the stock, soy sauce and tofu; simmer 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water.
Sprinkle with the ground Sichuan pepper and green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Lion's Head Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch, ginger and spring onion whites and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and cabbage; cover and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve the meatballs in bowls with the cabbage and broth.

recipes.title: Sichuan Cumin Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cumin, chili flakes and onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss in the coriander.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dry-Fried Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and sugar.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the green beans for 5 minutes until blistered, then the chilies and Sichuan pepper, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve right away while the beans are crisp.

recipes.title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the chili bean paste, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch and 4 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the eggplant until soft, then with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss until glossy.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the chili bean paste and star anise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Spicy Bean Paste Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the chili bean paste and star anise.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, daikon and water to just cover, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with Sichuan pepper and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the ground Sichuan pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the chili oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 3 tbsp water.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the numbing chili sauce over.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sichuan Dan Dan-Style Beef Noodles
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the ginger and garlic and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce and fry until the meat is crisp.
Divide the sesame paste, chili oil and Sichuan pepper between bowls, add the boiled noodles and bok choy and top with the crispy meat.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Ginger Beef Shogayaki

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, mirin, sake and grated ginger.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve with the raw shredded cabbage.

recipes.title: Japanese Yakisoba Beef Noodles

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce and ketchup.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the cabbage and carrot, then the noodles with the garlic and ginger for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss everything together until hot.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the onion.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Nikujaga-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the onion.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar, potatoes and carrots, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Let it sit 10 minutes so the potatoes soak up the sauce. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the onions until golden.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 700 ml water, the carrots, potatoes and apple, then stir in the curry roux for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Japanese Japanese Curry Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the onions until golden.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add 700 ml water, the carrots, potatoes and apple, then stir in the curry roux for the last 10 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve over rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Japanese Miso Flank Steak Bake
steps: Mix the miso, mirin, sugar and sake with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Grilled Japanese Yuzu Kosho-Style Flank Steak

ingredients.name: Yuzu kosho (or lemon zest and green chili)

steps: Mix the yuzu kosho, soy sauce and mirin with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Japanese Teriyaki Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and a pinch of salt only (the sauce is salty).
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar and let it bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Butter Ponzu Sirloin Steak

ingredients.name: Ponzu (or soy sauce with lemon juice)

steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the ponzu and butter and swirl until glossy.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with the spring onions.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Tsukune-Style Beef Patties
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, panko, spring onions, ginger and a pinch of salt and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir together the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and bubble until it coats the patties.
Serve glazed, with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Soboro Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook until dry and crumbly.
Scramble the eggs into fine curds separately, then top bowls of rice with the meat, egg and peas.
Serve with steamed short-grain rice.

recipes.title: Korean Bulgogi-Style Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Spicy Gochujang Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the gochujang, chili flakes, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion and cabbage with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Scatter with the green spring onions.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Japchae Beef Noodles

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms, then the spinach, then the cooked noodles with the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss well and serve warm or at room temperature.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Galbi Jjim-Style Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, mushrooms and water to just cover, adding the carrot and daikon for the last 40 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the gochujang and chili flakes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Dakdoritang-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the gochujang and chili flakes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the soy sauce, sugar, potatoes, carrots, onion and 600 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with the green spring onions. Taste for salt.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill and turn once.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with the green spring onions and serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Grilled Korean Galbi-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, grated pear, sesame oil and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Garlic Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and chili flakes and bubble until sticky.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Turn to coat.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, ginger and white parts of the spring onions for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the garlic and ginger and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Spoon over rice with the cucumber, spinach and a fried egg.
Serve with steamed rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the lemongrass, chili and onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Top with the coriander.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Shaking Beef Bo Luc Lac-Style

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion with the garlic and shallots for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Serve on the watercress and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Beef Kho

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Short Ribs Kho
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the sugar, cooked dry in the pot until dark amber, then.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the fish sauce, coconut water, pepper and eggs, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Reduce until the sauce is dark and sticky. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic and shallots for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, carrots, sweet potato and 300 ml water, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.

recipes.title: Grilled Vietnamese Lemongrass Flank Steak
steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, shallots, fish sauce and sugar with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with mint and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Nuoc Cham Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the garlic and shallots for 1 minute, then the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili and 3 tbsp water.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon over and scatter with mint.
Serve with rice or rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Bun Cha-Style Beef Patties
steps: Mix the beef with half the fish sauce, half the sugar, the garlic and shallots and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 8 patties or logs.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 8 minutes, turning, until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Cook the garlic and shallots gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Stir together the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice and 150 ml warm water as a dipping sauce.
Serve with the noodles, lettuce and herbs, dipping into the sauce.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, pepper and cinnamon.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Short Ribs Curry

Add the tamarind and 400 ml water, then the coconut milk for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Simmer until dark and thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Beef Curry

recipes.title: Indonesian Rendang-Style Braised Beef

Lower the heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, lemongrass, sugar and 200 ml water; uncover for the last hour and stir often until almost dry, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the toasted coconut and fry a few minutes more until dark. Taste for salt.

Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill; meanwhile simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, lime juice and chili flakes into a sauce.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with the peanut sauce.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng-Style Beef Fried Rice
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the shallots, garlic and chilies for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the shallots, garlic and chilies and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the cold rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and fry until hot and smoky.
Serve topped with a fried egg and cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Grilled Malaysian Ayam Percik-Style Flank Steak

Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill, basting with marinade twice.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with cucumber.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Beef

Reduce the sauce until it coats the meat. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Filipino Adobo Braised Short Ribs

recipes.title: Mexican Chipotle Beef Tinga

Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the chilies blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Verde Beef Guisado

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatillos, jalapeños and coriander blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with more coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Verde Short Ribs Guisado
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatillos, jalapeños and coriander blended with the stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Scatter with more coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Barbacoa-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chipotles blended with the vinegar and 300 ml water, plus the bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Squeeze over the lime and serve in tortillas. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Barbacoa-Style Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the chipotles blended with the vinegar and 300 ml water, plus the bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Squeeze over the lime and serve in tortillas. Taste for salt.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Achiote Flank Steak
steps: Mix the achiote paste, citrus juice, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish with the marinade.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with quick-pickled red onion.

recipes.title: Grilled Mexican Carne Asada-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, chili powder, coriander and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Shake off excess marinade.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice thinly and serve in tortillas with salsa.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Roast Mexican Al Pastor-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the soaked chilies, chipotles, pineapple juice, vinegar, cumin and garlic, blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on a lined tray with the pineapple slices around it.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Chop with the pineapple and serve in tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the chili powder, cumin and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the peppers and onion until charred at the edges, then a splash of water.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Slice the meat, squeeze over the lime and pile into tortillas.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Mole-Style Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mole paste and stock and simmer until thick, then melt in the chocolate.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the sauce over and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve with warm tortillas and rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Picadillo Beef Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the cumin and oregano and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and 150 ml water; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Serve with rice or in tortillas.

recipes.title: Mexican Albondigas Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, rice, mint and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes blended with the chipotle, then the stock; simmer the meatballs 25 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Serve as a soupy stew.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Chili con Carne Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the chili powder, cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with cheese and sour cream. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Chili con Carne Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the chili powder, cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with cheese and sour cream. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Cumin Lime Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the cumin, chili powder, lime juice and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the peppers and onion.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with tortillas and salsa.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Queso Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the chili powder.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the jalapeño, then the milk and cornstarch until thick; melt in the cheese off the heat.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the queso over.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Taco Beef
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the chili powder, cumin and paprika and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce and 100 ml water and simmer until thick.
Fill the taco shells with the meat, lettuce and cheese.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Enchilada Beef Bake

ingredients.name: Enchilada sauce (or tomato passata with chili)

steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the chili powder and cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in half the sauce and the beans.
Roll the filling in tortillas, cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.title: Jamaican Curry Beef Curry

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add 500 ml water and the potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Simmer uncovered until thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Curry Short Ribs Curry
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the curry powder, allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add 500 ml water and the potatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Simmer uncovered until thick. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Jamaican Brown Stew Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the browning sauce, ketchup and 400 ml water, with the carrots and pepper for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Jamaican Brown Stew Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the allspice and thyme.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the browning sauce, ketchup and 400 ml water, with the carrots and pepper for the last 15 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with rice. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Roast Jamaican Jerk Flank Steak
steps: Mix the jerk seasoning, allspice, sugar, lime, soy sauce, spring onions, garlic and scotch bonnet blended with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Sirloin Steak

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the allspice.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.

Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, garlic, spring onions and scotch bonnet for 1 minute, then the onion, carrot, pepper and scotch bonnet for 2 minutes, then the vinegar and sugar for 1 minute.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pour the hot pickled vegetables over.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.title: Cuban Ropa Vieja-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, wine, bay leaves and 300 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Ropa Vieja-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes, wine, bay leaves and 300 ml water; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Roast Cuban Mojo Flank Steak
steps: Mix the citrus juice, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish on the onion rings.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Mojo Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the cumin and oregano.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 1 minute, then the garlic for 1 minute, then the citrus juice; bubble 2 minutes.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the garlicky mojo over.
Serve with white rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Cuban Picadillo Beef Mince
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the cumin and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the tomato sauce, olives, raisins and capers and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice and fried plantains.

recipes.title: Peruvian Saltado Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain
Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Slice the beef into thin strips (if not already), toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt and leave while you prep.
For the sauce, stir together the soy sauce and vinegar with the tomatoes.

Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat until shimmering. Stir-fry the beef in two batches, about 2 minutes per batch, until browned outside but still a little pink inside; tip onto a plate.
Stir-fry the onion wedges and chili with the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes.
Return the beef with any juices, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and hot. Toss with the hot fries.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Roast Peruvian Pollo a la Brasa-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the soy sauce, lime, cumin, paprika, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay on the hot grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with green sauce and fries.

recipes.title: Peruvian Anticucho-Style Flank Steak Skewers

ingredients.name: Aji panca paste (or 2 tsp paprika and 1 tsp chili powder)

steps: Mix the vinegar, chili paste, cumin, oregano and garlic with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Thread on skewers and cook on the grill.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with boiled potatoes and corn.

recipes.title: Peruvian Seco-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces
Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coriander blended with the chili and beer, then the carrots for the last 30 minutes and the peas for the last 5, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Peruvian Seco-Style Short Ribs Stew

ingredients.name: Green chili (aji amarillo if you can find it)

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and ground cumin.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coriander blended with the chili and beer, then the carrots for the last 30 minutes and the peas for the last 5, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with rice and beans. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces
Palm oil (or olive oil with 1 tsp paprika)

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the coconut milk, pepper and tomatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Short Ribs Stew

ingredients.name: Palm oil (or olive oil with 1 tsp paprika)

steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the coconut milk, pepper and tomatoes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and stock, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Brazilian Churrasco-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the coarse salt and garlic only with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the onion, tomatoes, parsley and vinegar as a vinaigrette salsa.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with the salsa.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Brazilian Acebolado Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and the paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the onion rings in the butter until soft and golden, then the vinegar.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Pile the onions on top.
Serve with rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Grilled Argentine Chimichurri Flank Steak
steps: Mix salt, a little of the oregano and the oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Mix the parsley, garlic, the rest of the oregano, chili, vinegar and oil as chimichurri.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the chimichurri.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Salsa Criolla Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Meanwhile, off the heat, mix the onion, pepper, tomatoes, vinegar and oil for the salsa while the meat rests.
Spoon the salsa over.
Serve with roast potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Beef Stew

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Argentine Carbonada-Style Short Ribs Stew
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and paprika.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the tomatoes and stock, adding the vegetables and fruit for the last 30 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Serve in bowls. Taste for salt.

recipes.title: Italian Cacciatore Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the oregano and rosemary.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine (boil 1 minute), tomatoes, pepper and mushrooms, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Cacciatore Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the oregano and rosemary.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine (boil 1 minute), tomatoes, pepper and mushrooms, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the olives. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, passata, carrot, celery and bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Ragù Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, passata, carrot, celery and bay leaves; shred the meat at the end, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and vinegar, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the capers and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Peperonata Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and vinegar, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.
Stir in the capers and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Alla Pizzaiola Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and capers, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Stir in the olives and basil. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Alla Pizzaiola Braised Short Ribs
steps: Pat the short ribs dry and season well with salt and the oregano.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the short ribs in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and capers, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 3 hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the meat is falling off the bone.

recipes.title: Roast Italian Porchetta-Style Flank Steak
steps: Mix the fennel seeds, rosemary, lemon zest, chili and garlic with oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Lay in a roasting dish and pour the wine around.
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Lemon Rosemary Flank Steak Traybake
steps: Mix the lemon juice, rosemary, garlic and oil with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Coat the flank steak and leave to marinate 1 to 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat a grill, barbecue or ridged grill pan to medium-high. Spread on a tray with the potatoes, onion and lemon slices (start the potatoes 15 minutes earlier).
Grill about 5 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium).
Rest 5 minutes. Spoon over the pan juices.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Piccata Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the stock, lemon juice and capers and bubble 2 minutes, then swirl in the butter.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Marsala Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; dust lightly with flour.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then the Marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Saltimbocca-Style Sirloin Steak
steps: Pat the sirloin steak dry and season with salt and black pepper; lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each piece and press.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, turning once, until done to your liking (63 °C / 145 °F for medium). Rest on a warm plate.
Lower the heat and, in the same pan, cook the onion and garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and butter and bubble 1 minute.
Return the sirloin steak with its resting juices and turn in the sauce. Spoon the buttery sauce over.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Polpette Beef Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and half the garlic and 1 tsp salt; with wet hands shape into 16 balls.
Brown in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat in batches, about 6 minutes, turning; they finish cooking in the sauce.
Cook the onion and garlic gently in the same pan for 5 minutes.
Add the passata and simmer the meatballs gently for 20 minutes, until the meat is no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Tear over the basil and serve with bread or pasta.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Beef Ragù
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and the carrot and celery and cook, breaking it up, for 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink inside (71 °C / 160 °F).
Stir in the wine, then the passata; simmer 30 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Serve with crusty bread, polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: French Coq au Vin-Style Braised Beef

ingredients.name: Beef chuck, cut into 4 cm pieces

steps: Pat the beef dry and season well with salt and the thyme and flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches, about 12 minutes in total; set aside.
Lower the heat and cook the shallots and garlic for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.

Add the wine, bay leaves and 250 ml stock or water; fry the bacon, mushrooms and onions separately and add for the last 20 minutes, scrape up the browned bits and return the meat. Cover and simmer gently for about 2½ hours (or bake covered at 160 °C), until the beef is very tender.
Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.

Scatter with parsley. Taste for salt.
Serve with crusty bread, mashed potatoes or green beans.
